Italy
Kaylee, you did it! You won the Italy Explorer trophy!
Kaylee, Italy Explorer! From Italy.

text: Help me get ready to sing at the opera?

Tap the glowing pizza!
Where should we go next, Kaylee?
This spot opens soon!
Italy is shaped like a boot! Kick!
Help every friend first, then the opera can start!
Help friends to fill up Lupa's band!

text: Welcome to Naples! Pizza was born here!
Zio Bruno needs a helper chef!
Let me tell you the story of the most famous pizza!

Long ago, a queen named Margherita came to Naples.

text: For the Queen, I will make a special pizza!
Hello! I would love a pizza, please.

Flick the dough up to spin it!
Again! Flick it up!
Swirl the ladle to spread the sauce!
Tomatoes love the hot, sunny weather in Italy!
Put three pieces of white mozzarella on the pizza!
Now three green basil leaves!

text: Red, white and green, like the flag of Italy!

Slide the pizza into the oven!
This oven is super hot! Pizza bakes in ninety seconds!
Tap the pizza to turn it!
Turn it again!
It is golden! Pull the pizza out!
Tap the pizza to give it to the Queen!

text: So we call it pizza Margherita!
Fresh mozzarella, from my family's milk!

Mozzarella is made from milk. Some comes from buffalo!
Tap the order to start!
Put five olives on the pizza!
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
Five!
Six!
Seven!
Eight!
Oops, too many! Drag one off the pizza.
That's the order!
Cut it in half! Drag across the pizza.
Two halves!
Drag all the way across the pizza!

text: One half for me, one for my baby!

Tap the pizza to serve it!

text: Ciao! Half mushrooms, half olives, please!
I made this one for you. Watch!

Mushrooms go on this half!
Olives go on that half!
Put mushrooms on one half and olives on the other!
Cut it into four slices! Two cuts!
Now cut the other way!
Four slices!

text: Four slices, for me and my friends!

When someone says grazie, you say prego!

text: Now make a pizza just for YOU, Chef Kaylee!

Red sauce or pink sauce?
Red tomato sauce!
Pink beet sauce! Yum!
Put on anything you like!
Uh oh! Tap the sneaky cat!
Tap the check when you like it!
Cut it any way you like!
Mozzarella!
Basil!
Olive!
Mushroom!
Peperoni! In Italy, that means peppers!
Tomato!
Great job, Chef Kaylee!

text: Grazie, Chef Kaylee! A chef hat for you!
And my mandolin, for Lupa's band!
Yay! Our first friend for the band!
Ciao, Kaylee! The olives are ready!
Help me pick them for olive oil!

Drag the rake along the glowing branch!
Now comb this branch!
One more branch!
Slide the rake all the way to the end!

text: Eek! They stuck on my quills!

Tap Spina to shake them off!
Olives in the net!
Great combing, Kaylee!
The net is full!
Olive trees love hot, dry summers!
This olive is green. Tap the sun!
Purple! Tap the sun again!
Black! Now it is ripe!
Green, then purple, then black!
Green goes in the one sun bowl!
Purple goes in the two sun bowl!
Black goes in the three sun bowl!
Green, purple, black! Well done, Kaylee!
Fresh olives are too bitter!
They have to soak first.

text: Welcome to the frantoio, the olive mill!

Drop ten olives in the big funnel!
Drop an olive in the funnel!
Nine!
Ten!
It takes lots of olives to make oil!
Here comes the big stone wheel!
Look! Golden olive oil!
Hold the jug to pour! Fill it all the way!
Full! All the way to the top!
Now fill it halfway!
A little more, to the line!
Halfway full!
Olive oil goes on almost everything in Italy!

text: And my tambourine, for Lupa's band!

Tap the tambourine!

text: Yay! A tambourine for the band!

Tap the hill and listen!
Tap the rocks!
Long ago, a girl helped the Romans find water.
Today, that girl is YOU, Kaylee!
Build a water bridge to Rome!
Drag the arch that fits each gap!
Water only flows downhill!
Try the glowing arch!
Now tap an arch!
Now all the way to Rome! Look closely!
The Romans called a water bridge an aqueduct!
Tap the spring to turn on the water!
Follow the water with your finger!

text: The water is going to Rome!

The Romans built this water bridge!
That was 2,000 years ago!
And it still fills the fountain today!
Flick the coin up into the fountain!
Swipe up on the coin!
One more coin!
Now you will come back to Rome one day, Kaylee!
A wishing star!
It waits for Lupa's big night.
Coins from the fountain help people who need it.

text: I am Cesare, Emperor of the Colosseum!

Rome is hot and sunny in summer!
Pull the rope down to make shade!
Pull the next rope!
One more rope!
Drag the rope handle all the way down!
Long ago, sailors pulled the shade ropes!
Under the floor are secret tunnels and elevators!
Romans wrote numbers with lines!
Tap the door with the right number!
One line. One!
One, two lines. Two!
One, two, three lines. Three!
Four is one line, then a V!
Five looks like a V!
Pull the lever down!
Drag the lever all the way down!
Up goes the elevator!
A very, very slow bow!

text: Now the big doors: four and five!

V is five! Just like you, Kaylee!
Swipe across the crowd to make a wave!
Again! Make a wave!
The Colosseum is almost 2,000 years old!

text: Grazie, Kaylee. I bow to you.
My Roman horn, for Lupa's band!

Tap the horn!

text: Yay! A horn for the band!
My tower leans more and more! Help!

The tower leans because the ground is soft!
Drag a heavy weight to the high side!
Another weight!
One more weight!
Oops! Put it on the other side!
It still leans a little. That is why it is famous!
Builders really did this, with heavy weights!
Let's take the famous photo!
Drag Sparkle until her hoof holds up the tower!
Closer to the tower!
Say cheese! Snap!
A scientist named Galileo lived here!

text: Let's drop things from the top! Like Galileo!

Which one lands first? Tap it!
Tap the drop button!
They land at the same time!
Heavy and light fall just as fast!
The feather floats down slowly!
The air pushes the feather!
Now you pick! Tap two things to drop!
Pick one more!
You were right!
Good guess!

text: The tower is a bell tower! Seven bells!

Tap the bells, one by one!
Do, re, mi! Music!

text: Grazie! My bells, for Lupa's band!
Here the streets are water! Hop in!

Drag the oar back to row!
Again! Row, row!
Swipe the oar this way!
The canal splits in two!
Turn left!
Turn right!
Left is this hand!
Right is this hand!
Quack!
Try the other way!
A low bridge! Tap Sparkle to duck!
Venice has over four hundred bridges!
Look! In Venice, even ambulances are boats!
There are no cars in Venice!

text: Here we are! The mask shop!

Venice has a big costume party called Carnevale!
Paint this side of the mask!
Look! The other side paints itself!
Both sides match, like a mirror!
Paint a little more!
Tap a color!
Now add three sparkly gems!
Drag a gem onto the mask!
Sparkle, try it on!
So pretty, Kaylee!
Tap the sky for fireworks!
The fireworks shine in the water!
Tap the accordion!

text: Yay! An accordion for the band!
It's so hot! Let's get snow from the volcano!

Drag Nino up the path!
Drag Nino along the path, up the mountain!

text: Phew! So hot by the beach!

Lemons grow here in the hot sun!
A scarf for Nino!
The higher you go, the colder it gets!
Drag snow into Nino's baskets!
Drag the snow onto Nino!
Etna is a volcano! It puffs smoke!
Etna is the tallest volcano in Europe!
Tap Nino to zoom down!
Long ago, people brought snow down from Etna.
They made icy treats called granita!
Tap the basket to scoop snow!
Two scoops for Mona! Tap the basket!
One more scoop!
Press and hold the lemon to squeeze!
Keep holding!
Sicily has the best lemons!
Tap the granita to give it away!
Brain freeze! Hee hee!
Italy has snowy mountains and hot, sunny beaches!

text: I'm strong! I'll carry the piano to Lupa's band!

The piano was invented in Italy!
Tap the piano keys!

text: Yay! A piano for the band!

This arena is almost 2,000 years old!
Tap the seats to light the candles!
More candles!
So many little lights!
You are the conductor, Kaylee! Here is your wand!
Swing the wand big!
Big swings play loud! Forte means loud!
Now swing it tiny!
Tiny swings play soft! Piano means soft!
Move your finger back and forth!
Tap a friend for a solo!
A solo!
Look! Lupa's wishing star! Tap it!

text: I sang! My wish came true!

Catch the roses!
Look up! The Italian air show!
Green, white and red! Like a pizza Margherita!
Tap the trophy!
Brown bear sticker! Bears live in the mountains of Italy!
Porcupine sticker! Crested porcupines live in Italy!
Cat sticker! Lots of cats live in the old ruins of Rome!
Little owl sticker! Little owls live all over Italy!
Pigeon sticker! Lots of pigeons live in Venice!
Donkey sticker! Donkeys carry things up the hills of Sicily!
Wolf sticker! The story says a kind mama wolf took care of the twins who built Rome!
Let's see how olive oil is made!
Let's toss a coin in the real Trevi Fountain!
Look! A real Roman water bridge!
Let's see the real Colosseum in Rome!
Let's see the real Leaning Tower!
Let's ride a real gondola in Venice!
Look! The real Mount Etna!
In Italy, people say ciao! It means hello and goodbye!
Grazie means thank you!
One, two, three in Italian: uno, due, tre!
Italy is shaped like a boot, kicking a ball!
Italy has hot, sunny summers, and snowy mountains up north!
Pizza comes from Naples, in Italy!
Pizza Margherita is red, white and green, like Italy's flag!
Long ago, the Romans built roads, arenas and water bridges!
Italy has volcanoes! One is right next to Naples!
Italy's flag has three stripes: green, white and red!
Some olive trees in Italy are more than a thousand years old!
Romans wrote five like this: V!
The Leaning Tower of Pisa leans because the ground is soft!
Buongiorno means good morning!
In Venice, the streets are water! People ride in boats!
The piano and the violin were first made in Italy!
Gelato is Italian ice cream! Yum!
The Pantheon in Rome has a big hole in its roof. When it rains, rain falls inside!
The story says a kind mama wolf took care of the twins who built Rome!
This is Italy! Tap a picture to learn more.
